# Card 372: preliminary single-reader candidate

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1691) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5133/pc_hcp_372_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5134/pc_hcp_372_adr.JPG) · [Full evidence JSON](372.json)

**Partial research candidate; not a solved card.** One key-visible AI source reading was frozen before the first computational decode. Subsequent source review and interpretation used the same context and were nonblind. A second source reading and external confirmation are still needed.

Crossed/smeared cluster in main-1 and raised question-shaped mark in main-5 are masked; numeral/date-like cluster near end of main-8 is masked as role and segmentation unresolved. No ordinary date authentication.

The original images/crops remain private. Picture SHA256: `e595b1c1f61ce8067ec9be4b26ca42f471990ae6cfcdcbbdaf7503fb8524faa6`. Coordinates and full acquisition metadata are in the JSON. Ordinary dates, addresses and postal text are excluded without historical authentication.

## Readable fragments

These are separate editorial proposals tied to exact literal fragments. They are not a continuous translation; omitted stretches remain unresolved. Czech diacritics are editorial.

**372-main-1**, literal `VRELY DI? ?A VCEREJSI LISTE?`

[Vřelý dík za včerejší lístek?; DI?/LISTE? require q → K, ?A requires g → Z.]

[Warm thanks for yesterday’s little letter?; conditional q/g choices.]

[Po vysvětlení. S plánem sděleným souhlasím; only these fragments.]

[For an explanation. I agree with the communicated plan; only these fragments.]

**372-main-4**, literal `A TESIM SE VELICE.`

[A těším se velice.]

[And I look forward to it very much.]

**372-main-6**, literal `JA MAM TENTO?RATE MNOHO PRACE.`

[Já mám tentokráte mnoho práce?; TENTO?RATE requires q → K.]

[I have a lot of work this time?; TENTO?RATE requires q → K.]

**372-main-7**, literal `TISIC UPRIMNYCH PO?DRAVU A PUS POSILA TI TVUJ`

[Tisíc upřímných pozdravů a pus posílá ti tvůj…; ? → Z and provisional CH.]

[A thousand sincere greetings and kisses are sent to you by your…; ? → Z and provisional CH.]

`?` may cover an unknown-length cluster. Oval-descender q/g ambiguity remains masked. `ř` provisionally expands to CH; r plus an unattached mark remains an alternative. Awkward output is retained. Source spacing/line breaks do not prove linguistic joins or relative block order.

proposed_czech:
Vřelý dík za včerejší lístek. Nevím, [mám-li?] ujištění [Aničky?] bezpodmínečně věřiti a toužím po vysvětlení. S plánem sděleným souhlasím a těším se velice. Není mému srdéčku ještě ničeho známo o dnu zpovědi? — Svátky [trávíš?] veseleji než já, mám tentokráte mnoho práce.

Tisíc upřímných pozdravů a pus posílá ti tvůj Pepouš. Lístek z [koncertu?] došel teprve 29. odpoledne.
proposed_english:
Warm thanks for yesterday’s letter. I do not know [whether I should?] believe [Anička’s?] assurance unconditionally, and I long for an explanation. I agree with the plan you communicated and look forward to it very much. Does my sweetheart still know nothing about the day of confession? — You are [spending?] the holidays more cheerfully than I am; I have a lot of work this time.

A thousand sincere greetings and kisses to you from your Pepouš. The card from the [concert?] only arrived on the afternoon of the 29th.
